description: Marks an account as a Resenha reader. Resenha's server reads it to know who uses Resenha, and whether they agreed to be suggested to other readers.

main.description: One per account, with the record key self. Written by the app after sign-in, and deleted when the reader leaves Resenha's directory.

createdAt.description: When the reader started using Resenha.

discoverable.description: Whether the reader may be suggested to others: in Discover, the reader directory and Resenha's starter pack. Their public records are public either way.

languages.description: Languages the reader reads in, most used first, to rank what Discover suggests.
